prompt:
Rewrite snippets/event-schedule-list.liquid so it renders a workshop schedule with correct counts and pluralization. Inputs. There is one top-level variable, `events`. There is no section object. - `events`: array, never null, may be empty. Each object has: - `name`: string or null. - `sessions`: integer, 0 or greater. - `seats_left`: integer 0 or greater, or null. - `cancelled`: boolean. Counting. Events with cancelled true are excluded from the list and from the event and session totals. Count them separately as K. - E = number of non-cancelled events. - S = sum of `sessions` over non-cancelled events. Output. Produce the following with no whitespace between or around any tags. 1. Always output exactly one summary paragraph: `

TEXT

`. - If E is 0, TEXT is `No upcoming events`. - Otherwise TEXT is `E event` (when E is 1) or `E events`, then `, `, then `S session` (when S is 1) or `S sessions`. Zero takes the plural, e.g. `2 events, 0 sessions`. - In both cases, if K > 0, append ` (K cancelled)` to TEXT, e.g. `No upcoming events (2 cancelled)` or `1 event, 1 session (1 cancelled)`. 2. If E > 0, follow the summary with `
    `, one `
  • ` per non-cancelled event in input order, then `
`. If E is 0, output no ul. 3. Each li is `

  • NAME

    SESSIONSSEATS
    • `. - NAME: the name trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace and HTML-escaped. If the name is null or blank after trimming, NAME is `Untitled event`. - SESSIONS: - `No sessions` when sessions is 0; - `1 session` when it is 1; - otherwise `N sessions`. - SEATS: - nothing when seats_left is null; - `Sold out` when it is 0; - `Only 1 seat left` when it is 1; - `Only N seats left` when it is 2 to 5 inclusive; - `N seats left` when it is greater than 5. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/event-schedule-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
